speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Mend the back. And when you write, say something.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll mend what a road can mend. And when I write, I will say something. Not a price. Not a prettier no.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt say it in words I can keep, or the walk is only a walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The children are asleep. I will not wake them to be brave at a door.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: They had thee at the pie. That is enough of thee for one night. Go while the grey is still grey.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard has the pack. I am not to help, and I am not to describe the knot.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then do not describe it to me. Six, at the bridge. Come back with a back that can sit a bench, and a sentence that is a sentence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will come back. I am not saying when, and I am not saying with a house.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I did not ask thee for the house at a door. I asked thee for the back, and for something said. Hold to those.
